Startup instructions refer to retained absolute paths/PIDs/owner containers; shell restoration or snapshot contents do not prove those services are currently healthy.
Configured repository ref remainsmain while current feature isPR30. Existing root restored atmain/work; new authorized independent worktree used. Do not checkout/reset original root.
Environment installer uses live Debian trixie APT and pip editable dev install; this differs from immutable native-tool OCI/APT provenance. Not a replacement for native build/release evidence.

recommendation: Keep revision14 saved and unapplied. Prepare a subsequent bounded startup-only proposal after current independent worktree/services are validated; do not publish snapshot or rewrite old state.
